title: Java 8 Features for Freshers
intro: Java 8 features (fresher level) introduces the modern Java style. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with lambda expressions (the syntax revolution), then functional interfaces (the SAM types lambdas target) and method references. Streams follow — the centerpiece — split into basics and operations. Optional (the null-handling companion) and default/static interface methods close the feature tier, then comparisons.
